outputs.explanation: Panel A shows pseudocoloured confocal micrograph images of nuclei during photoactivation time-lapse experiments; it is a micrograph panel, not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B consists of line/scatter plots of normalized fluorescence intensity vs. time for euchromatin (red) and heterochromatin (green). The main graphs already display the individual measured data points (scattered red squares and green diamonds) with model fit lines overlaid, so individual data are visible rather than only averaged curves. The insets show averaged early time-point responses with error bars, which fall under the line-plot exemption (overlaying every individual point on a time-series average would make it unreadable).
